quote: We focus on three different tasks to illustrate the versatility of our metrics and the new insights they can provide. ... WebText generation, Biographies generation, Creative texts generation.

We task the models with generating creative texts... We also evaluate Wikipedia-like biographies and WebText continuation, illustrating the versatility of our metrics on open-ended text generation tasks.

In recent years and months, there has been a rapid democratization of Large Language Models (LLMs), exemplified by platforms such as Chat-GPT and HuggingChat. These models are now widely accessible for a diverse range of tasks, from composing emails and application letters to performing multi-document summarization, generating medical prescriptions, and even crafting poetry and novels.
outputs: Generated texts (e.g., continuations, biographies, creative writings)
Generated text continuations, biographies, creative writings, topic-modeled articles

The paper evaluates generated outputs in open-ended text generation tasks such as continuing WebText prompts, generating Wikipedia-like biographies, and producing creative texts based on manual prompts.

quote: We introduced Precision and Recall as automated metrics for comparing generative model outputs against a reference distribution.
We compute Precision, Recall, MAUVE, Self-BLEU and Distinct-4 as automatic metrics and analyze their correlations with traditional metrics such as Perplexity and BLEU.

We adapt the concepts of Precision and Recall, traditionally used in image generation, to evaluate the performance of large language models. Our method offers a novel lens to assess the quality and diversity of text generation without the need for aligned corpora.
we conducted a mock-human evaluation using GPT-3.5-turbo

We conducted a mock-human evaluation using GPT-3.5-turbo. To evaluate the quality, we ask GPT-3.5-turbo to rate our generated biographies on three dimensions: coherence, insightfulness and Wikipedia-likeness. We also experimented with a proxy of diversity, by asking GPT-3.5-turbo to rate the similarity of batches of 10 texts.
